meta.name: cryogenic-frontiers
meta.author: sonip362
meta.description:
A complete standalone cryogenic technology ecosystem and expansion for Mindustry.
100% self-contained: features zero dependencies on vanilla resources, ammo, or crafting trees.

Features:
- Command Cores (3 Tiers): Core: Frost (3x3), Core: Glacier (4x4), Core: Cryosphere (5x5)
- Core Constructor Units (3): Frost Alpha, Frost Beta, Frost Gamma
- Natural Ores (6): Glacite, Cryo-Shale, Boreonite, Polar Quartz, Frost-Magnetite, Boreal Clathrate
- Industrial Materials (12): Subzero Silicon, Cryo-Glass, Gelid Polymer, Cryo-Fiber, Endothermic Salt, Cryo-Processor, Aero-Glacite, Superconducting Solenoid, Cryo-Crystal, Cryo-Alloy, Cryo-Nanites, Quantum Condensate
- Refineries & Chemical Plants (11): Cryo-Synthesizer, Cryo-Glass Kiln, Polymer Press, Fiber Extruder, Endothermic Vat, Processor Assembler, Cavitation Foundry, Solenoid Winder, Cryo-Crystallizer, Industrial Crystallizer, Cryo-Alloy Foundry, Nanite Fabricator, Quantum Condenser
- Combat Units (6 across 2 Tiers):
  * Tier 1: Boreas (interceptor), Sleet (walker mech), Icebreaker (naval cutter)
  * Tier 2: Tempest (heavy strike craft), Hailstorm (armored assault mech), Glacier Cruiser (naval battlecruiser)
- Unit Facilities (3): Cryo Unit Factory, Cryo Naval Shipyard, Cryo Reconstructor
- Power & Grid: Cryo Hydro-Turbine (shallow water), Thermo-Stirling Engine, Zero-Point Cryo-Reactor, Cryo Node, Large Cryo Node
- Logistics Suite: Complete solid & liquid cryogenic transport networks
- Heavy Turrets: Frostbite, Permafrost, Absolute Zero, Glacialis Railgun, Blizzard Rotary Cannon, Avalanche Torpedo Launcher
- Fortifications: Glacite Walls, Cryo Nova Walls, Shielded Superconducting Walls
- Custom Campaign Planet: Nivalis (4 Progressive Sectors with custom environmental blocks, 4+ min prep timers, and climax 2-Core Attack Map)
